_meta.name: Waco Wedgelok (steel, 76 cm, imperial bays)
_meta.note: US modular system (verticals with wedge clusters, load-bearing transoms, non load-bearing ledgers). Values from the 1999 Waco training guide (Fig. 17.1 parts table, imperial, converted). Not a weight catalogue: verify on real parts. 'verified' = false everywhere.
sources: 850794956-Waco-Guide-to-Scaffolding-1999.pdf p.34 (Fig. 17.1 Waco Wedgelok, printed p.33): codes and weights (lb) of verticals, transoms, ledgers, steel planks, diagonal braces, jack

850794956-Waco-Guide-to-Scaffolding-1999.pdf p.35 (printed 34): cluster pitch 1'7-11/16", vertical 6'6" drawing (10-9/16" + 3 x 19-11/16" + 9-1/16"), ledgers non load-bearing and used as guardrail/midrail

850794956-Waco-Guide-to-Scaffolding-1999.pdf p.36 (printed 35): transoms load-bearing (A1 2'-4', bow-string A2 5'-10'), brace clamps to 1.9" tube, steel plank 8-3/4" x 2-1/2" spanning transom to transom
850794956-Waco-Guide-to-Scaffolding-1999.pdf p.37 (printed 36): ties max 30 ft horizontal / 26 ft vertical (OSHA), 6'6" max vertical spacing between horizontals
850794956-Waco-Guide-to-Scaffolding-1999.pdf p.17 (printed 16): toeboards 1/2 lb/ft (1" x 6" timber, worked example)
changes: Node spacing 500 mm, not 508: p.34 rounds the cluster pitch to 20", but the dimensioned vertical on p.35 gives 1'7-11/16" = 500.1 mm; the 6'6" vertical is 4 pitches (78.7" = 1999 mm). Lift = 4 clusters = 2000 mm, which is the 6'6" max vertical spacing of p.37.
Standards: l_mm = cluster module (1000/1500/2000/3000) instead of the nominal 3'3"/4'11"/6'6"/9'10" (990/1499/1981/2997), so that stacked verticals keep the 500 mm pitch; nominal kept in each note.
Width: 2'6" transom 0801-26 (762 mm c/c) + 1.9" tube = 810 mm; 3 steel planks 8-3/4" (222 mm) = 667 mm usable. Other transoms (2'-10') exist; this preset fixes the 2'6" width.
Bays 5'-10' use the 0802 ledgers; the short fitting bays 3' and 4' use the A1 transoms 0801-30/0801-40 as ledgers and rails (no 3'/4' ledger in the table). Planks exist for every bay length.
Guard rails = the same ledgers (p.35: 'ledgers also serve as guardrails and midrails'). End guard rail = 2 transoms 2'6" (2 x 2.72 kg).
Diagonal brace height is not printed: assumed one 2000 mm lift; l_mm computed from bay x 2000.
No access deck with hatch in Wedgelok (only stair stringers 7'/8' and treads, ladder 0805-66 without weight): access_deck list empty, the engine places no access deck and warns.
No base collar: verticals join by coupler 0805-10 (no weight printed, not counted).

Base jack: only the 2 ft R.O. jack 0805-20 (9 lb) is listed, max extension not printed -> rules.jack_ext_max_ratio default (0.68 x 610 = 415 mm). Waco's 12" max screw extension (p.16/p.19) is stated for frame adjustment screws, not for this jack.
Toeboards: none in the Wedgelok table; estimated at 1/2 lb/ft = 0.74 kg/m (Waco p.17 example, 1" x 6" timber) via rules.toeboard_est_kg_per_m; end toeboard estimated the same way.
Ties: no tie hardware in the guide; wall tie 2.9 kg, coupler 1.0 kg, eyebolt 0.2 kg estimated (values used by the other draft presets).
Load class: transoms rated for OSHA light duty 25 psf = 1.2 kN/m2 (p.35-36), recorded as max_load_kn_m2 1.2 (below EN class 2).

system.connection: captive wedge in radiused C-flange, driven into a cluster on the vertical (+/-30 deg); verticals joined by removable coupler 0805-10

rules_verified.note: Waco gives only the OSHA upper limit for ties (30 ft x 26 ft = 9.14 x 7.92 m, i.e. 72 m2 per tie) and says bracing/tying follow the leg load and the drawings; engine defaults kept (22 m2, brace every 5 bays). toeboard 1/2 lb/ft from the Waco p.17 example.
